evidence: MEASURED on reports/archie_loop_abcreal_v11_e600.jsonl: n=600, old compiled(=ok)=15 (2.5%), new compiled(=a volume was measured)=414 (69.0%) -- a 27.6x understatement. 399 of the 585 'not compiled' rounds carry a measured volume; re-running one through the pinned verifier gives ok=False valid=True volume=183851.88 with 4 FAIL / 1 PASS assertions. THREE defect sites fixed, not the two identified by the scout (moe_gate.py:589 plus its prose header). Gate tools/selfconsist/test_compiled_is_a_build_signal.py 9/9 including a negative control (real build failure reads False under both definitions, no volume key) and a positive control (12/12 sampled real emissions diverge).

Producer wired: forge-guardian now writes /tmp/archie_health/status.json (state/swap_gib/halt/gpu_jobs/producer), verified live and fresh at age 0s. Four consumers inverted to fail CLOSED: missing->UNKNOWN, stale(>600s)->STALE, unparseable->UNREADABLE, healthy->GREEN, ORANGE passes through. Gate tools/selfconsist/test_health_fails_closed.py 25/25, extracting the LIVE health() via ast rather than restating the rule. Positive control: the OLD function run under the same missing-file condition returns GREEN, proving a behaviour change not a passing state. End-to-end: HALT flag propagates within one poll and clears.
